title: Bipartite monochromatic path partition conjecture
statement: Let $K_{n,n}$ be a balanced complete bipartite graph whose edges are coloured with $r$ colours. A **vertex-partition into monochromatic paths** is a partition of all vertices into paths, each having edges of one colour. **Bipartite path partition conjecture.** Suppose that the edges of $K_{n,n}$ are coloured with $r$ colours. There is a vertex-partition of $K_{n,n}$ into $2r-1$ monochromatic paths. This conjecture would generalise the paper's earlier result for balanced complete bipartite graphs and is proposed as a direction beyond complete graphs.
source_name: Alexey Pokrovskiy, “Partitioning edge-coloured complete graphs into monochromatic cycles and paths”, arXiv:1205.5492 (2012).
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2007–2012). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:math/0702354](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0702354).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1205.5492

Status: **open** according to the source (as of May 2012). “This conjecture is open for $r\geq 3$.”
